name: Artillery Mcp
description: Artillery 2.x load-testing via MCP — one-command install for @kosiakmd/artillery-mcp. Ships a stdio MCP server with 18 tools (run_test_from_file, run_fargate, read_artillery_output, parse_results, run_report, compare_results, etc.) plus an agent SKILL.md with decision tree, call patterns, and gotchas. Config-driven: drop an .artillery-mcp.config.json at your project root and a 19th run_project_lt tool appears for one-liner flow×environment launches. Uses the published @kosiakmd/artillery-mcp npm package via npx caret-minor pin (patch fixes flow through automatically). MIT, open source, multi-arch Docker image also available. Prerequisites: Node 20+, artillery CLI on PATH.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `artillery-mcp` (Use when running, parsing, or comparing Artillery load tests via the @kosiakmd/artillery-mcp MCP server) and **1 MCP server**, `artillery-mcp`.

Installs with `claude plugin install artillery-mcp@claude-community` from `kosiakMD/artillery-mcp-plugin` (`plugins/artillery-mcp`).
